question: How does repeated offering across regained bodies lead to the status of a supreme animal after six times?
premises: An offering is made, and a body is obtained again in sequence.
That process is repeated, with offering again, six times in this manner.
The one who undergoes this here becomes a supreme animal of six births.
inference: Repeated offering across successive regained bodies, carried out six times, results in the status of a supreme animal marked by six births.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether six births are completed or counted prospectively.
The precise link between regained body and renewed offering remains open.
plain_english: Offered once and again obtaining a body, offered again, six times thus: he here becomes a supreme animal of six births.
